objective: Recover Add Event's shared Calendar and relative When input with a live selection boundary and explicit locale ownership.

context_delta.dg_02: The Event host resolves locale and owns prose; the parser takes an explicit locale and returns error codes; generic Calendar takes explicit locale and supplied labels without importing Event code.
context_delta.range_validity: A first-click start=end range is valid even when complete=false; complete is click-cycle phase only.
context_delta.locale_switch: Reformat cached valid results and rerender labels without clearing or reparsing the valid draft.
